name: withdraw
description: Withdraw your own request that still waits for the person: a held write, a revert or a plugin approval, for example when the person tells you to cancel it. Name exactly one of approvalId (a held write's, from write or list_pending, or a plugin approval's, from request_plugin) or revertId (from request_revert), with reason: why, as you heard it from the person, in 1 to 500 characters; the person reads it. The request's link then shows it withdrawn with your reason, and it can never be signed: nothing changes. Only your own request can be withdrawn; another agent's is NOT_FOUND. A request that no longer waits (signed, applied, rejected, expired or withdrawn already) answers its state and nothing changes. Show personMessage to the person.

approvalId.description: The held write or plugin approval to withdraw. Exactly one of approvalId and revertId.

revertId.description: The revert to withdraw. Exactly one of approvalId and revertId.

reason.description: Why the request is withdrawn, as you heard it from the person. Shown on its page.

kind.description: APPROVAL: a held write. REVERT: a revert. PLUGIN_APPROVAL: a plugin approval.

approvalId.description: APPROVAL and PLUGIN_APPROVAL: the id withdrawn.

status.description: WITHDRAWN: the request is withdrawn (by this call or an earlier one) and can never be signed. Any other status: the request no longer waited for the person, so nothing changed; it is the request's state.

reason.description: WITHDRAWN: the reason recorded with it.

personMessage.description: The message to show the person: the request is withdrawn and nothing changed, or its state when it no longer waited.

links.description: The URLs of personMessage with labels, in order; present exactly when personMessage holds a URL (never, today).

nextSteps.description: What to do next (CONTRACT.md, Next steps): tell the person; never ask them to sign a withdrawn request.
